statement: A stable canvas can provide a spatial/temporal reference frame while annotations target specific regions or time spans.
actakit_implication: Evidence locators should target a specific Representation plus a typed spatial/temporal selector.

statement: Coordinate/size rounding and edge tiles have implementation-dependent behavior.
actakit_implication: Persist selector scheme/version and sufficient context; do not assume derived pixel coordinates survive every rendering pipeline.

statement: Different compliant services may support different targeting capabilities.
actakit_implication: Representation adapters must advertise capabilities; unsupported selectors degrade explicitly rather than being guessed.
